messages:
sahil: Heads-up — I'm prepping onlp-gpt-small for quantization push to staging. Quick precheck notes and questions below, looking for a couple of quick thumbs before we run the full AWQ job.

sahil: TL;DR — weights at s3://redwood-models/onlp-gpt-small/v1/, tokenizer is byte-level (not BPE), default config had max_seq_len=1024 but our eval slices 2048, AWQ calibration: I'm planning 2k samples, GPTQ runs used 8k earlier. FP8 micro-bench looks promising (~2x token/s) but MMLU drop ~0.8% vs fp16. Need consensus on calib size and fallback policy.

eva: thanks. tokenizer quirk — is that the HF tokenizer or our internal fast tokenizer? Any vocab mismatch risk for chat prompts?

sahil: HF byte-level tokenizer present in repo under models/onlp-gpt-small/tokenizer/; there is a small special-token order change compared to other models ("<usr>"/"<sys>"). I ran a quick tokenize roundtrip and got 0.03% OOV-like tokens on our prompt set. Probably fine but calling it out.

maria: can you paste the AWQ config you're going to use? also which calibration dataset? we should avoid sampling bias (no docs-only prompts).

sahil: config snippet: 

```
quant_method: AWQ
bits: 4
block_size: 128
calibration:
  samples: 2048
  dataset: s3://redwood-calib/llm-mix/llm-lmsys-2k-sample.jsonl
  seed: 42
runtime_flags:
  kv_cache_prefetch: true
  clip_stats: false

# fallback policy
fallback:
  min_accuracy_drop: 1.5  # percent
  fallback_to: awq-6b-8k-gptq-compatible
```

sahil: command I'm about to run: `./quantize --model s3://redwood-models/onlp-gpt-small/v1/ --out s3://redwood-quant/onlp-gpt-small/awq-4b-2k/ --config quant.yaml`

calib-bot: Calibration job queued (job_id=cal-1778801257). Expected runtime ~45m for 2k samples on p4d-slice.

darren: quick question on metrics — what passes as acceptable tradeoff for product? FP8 gave 0.8% MMLU drop but 1.9x throughput. Is 1% drop acceptable if latency halves?

maria: for customer-facing retrieval+rank flows, anything above 1.0% MMLU drop needs product alignment. For internal assistant latency-sensitive paths, 1% is OK. Which routes are we targeting?

sahil: initial target = emb/chat-svc (latency-sensitive), but we plan staged rollout: 10% canary -> 50% if no regressions. So 1% threshold sounds right. I'll set min_accuracy_drop=1.0 in the config.

calib-bot: Calibration finished (job_id=cal-1778801257). samples=2048, elapsed=38m, stored artifacts at s3://redwood-quant/onlp-gpt-small/awq-4b-2k/artifacts.tar.gz

sahil: result summary from eval harness (short):
```
Eval set: redwood/evals/core-llm-suite-2k
MMLU(fp16): 58.2
MMLU(awq-4b-2k): 57.4  (-0.8)
Perplexity(fp16): 12.1
Perplexity(awq-4b-2k): 12.6 (+4.1%)
Throughput(fp16): 180 tok/s
Throughput(awq-4b-2k): 340 tok/s (+1.9x)
```

maria: those look inline with expectations. Can you add a small smoke test against the chat prompt template to ensure no tokenization drift? If that passes, I'm +1 for staging canary.

eva: also please include a short note in the release PR about the special-token order and add a unit test for roundtrip tokenization.

sahil: will do. Pushing PR now: https://git.redwood.local/r/onlp/quant-prs/issue-342 (draft).

deploy-bot: Staging deploy (canary=10%) queued for image: onlp-gpt-small:awq-4b-2k (triggered by sahil). CI: 4/4 green.

darren: quick CR ping @maria @eva — if no objections by EOD I'll merge and let deploy-bot run the canary.

maria: LGTM, thanks for the clear summary. :thumbsup:

eva: LGTM — added tokenization test in the PR thread. :white_check_mark:

sahil: thanks all — will monitor traces/dashboard (route: chat-svc/canary) and post any anomalies here.

sahil: follow-up note: I bumped calibration samples to 3k in a follow-up run (just in case) — results will be posted here when ready.

calib-bot: Calibration job queued (job_id=cal-1778801540) for 3k samples. ETA ~1h.
